scientific_integrity: All-depth estimates use an analytic proof; integer finite-depth enumeration and numerical two-input tests are supplementary. Originality assessment has explicit inaccessible-paper and historical-priority risks. No independent review claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-depth finite maximization and two-sided logarithmic bounds, not an all-depth simplified closed form. Exact finite values certified at depths 1 through 8. Applies to real aligned orthonormal Haar data, uniform positive threshold and open-path unweighted first variation.
title: Logarithmic two-input BV instability of dyadic Haar soft thresholding
